source_title: Centre’s Diwali gift to pensioners, staff: 3% DA hike - The Times of India
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Ahead of Diwali, Union Cabinet Wednesday approved a 3% hike in DA for central government employees and dearness relief (DR) for pensioners.
